channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Moviment Graffitti launches crowdfunding to appeal db tower height increase
item.description: Moviment Graffitti launches crowdfunding campaign to finance a legal appeal against a Planning Authority decision that allows an additional 13 storeys on the controversial db project in Pembroke

item.title: Gozo Channel to suspend ferry crossings on Christmas and New Year
item.description: Gozo Channel will suspend its ferry service for three hours on Christmas Day and New Year’s Day, with passengers advised to plan ahead as several midday crossings will not operate

item.title: Woman suffers grievous injuries in Mosta traffic accident
item.description: A 70-year-old woman from Mosta was hospitalised with grievous injuries after being struck by a car in a traffic accident on Independence Avenue on Friday morning

item.title: Momentum warns rising debt interest costs are draining public funds
item.description: Political party Momentum has warned that Malta is spending €261 million a year on interest payments alone, arguing that rising debt servicing costs are threatening investment in public services and long-term economic sustainability

item.title: Police arrest 46 living or working in Malta illegally
item.description: In a statement, police said that the arrests were made during inspections in Marsa and Paola, as authorities stopped a number of cars

item.title: World peace and global harmony: A utopian dream?
item.description: With such a grim baggage, can mankind ever dream of a lasting, just world peace and global harmony?

item.title: Putin says Russia will not start other wars if it is respected
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin again said he was willing to end the conflict peacefully but did not seem keen on compromises

item.title: PA set to sanction Polidano’s illegal works in Balzan
item.description: The permit would regularise works related to two permits revoked by the EPRT and the law courts as well as additional works undertaken without any authorisation

item.title: Gaffarena’s Żebbuġ ‘sheep farm’ set for refusal
item.description: The Planning Authority’s Development Management Directorate has recommended the refusal of an outline application seeking to sanction existing structures and convert them into a sheep farm on a rural site in Triq it-Tnax ta’ Mejju, Żebbuġ

item.title: A decree during mediation remains valid despite no action instituted within stipulated time
item.description: A maintenance order is still valid, although separation proceedings were not instituted within two months from the end of mediation
